original_threads.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Reindex an extended hook list after removing the tail**

When a `TransactionCommitting`, `afterCommit`, or `TransactionCommitted` callback appends a `beforeStartingTransaction` hook during this operation, the array remains a list containing the owned tail followed by the new hook. `array_filter` removes the middle element but preserves its numeric keys, so the next feature operation rejects the stored hooks at the `array_is_list($hooks)` check and all subsequent listening/preferences operations become unavailable until the worker is reset. Preserve associative replacement arrays, but reindex when removing the tail from a list.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

<!-- codex-code-review-finding:v1 -->

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Disable invalid playlist creation submissions**

After loading an initialized library, this submit button is enabled while `name` is initially empty, and it also remains enabled for whitespace-only names or after the playlist limit is reached. Those inputs are rejected by `ProductionListeningState::validateCommand`, but the client treats every failed mutation as uncertain, clears the library, and forces a reload, so an accidental click on the immediately available button disrupts the journey. Disable submission unless the trimmed name is valid and the playlist count is below the provided limit.
